## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the boundary changed.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots or a short recording
- [ ] No secrets, personal state, build output, or `.claude-codex` artifacts are included

## Compatibility

Note data migrations, Provider/ACP capability changes, update compatibility, or tests that could not be run.
